applies_why: The judge text resolves a verse-based challenge and expressly says it was answered in named rounds, so K-G4's rule that answered verses are not counted governs it.
quote: answered in [CR2] section G and [CR3] LINK 5.
rule_words: A verse the judge says was answered is not counted.
why: Because the judge treats the challenge as answered in the named rounds rather than counting any verse as an unanswered witness toward a broken link, it does not violate K-G4.
